title: The Structural Origin of Attention Sink: Variance Discrepancy, Super Neurons, and Dimension Disparity

summary.en: Traces attention sinks to variance differences created by value aggregation and amplified by FFN super neurons. Controlled interventions test the proposed causal chain; head-wise RMSNorm is studied as a way to stabilize aggregation statistics during pretraining.
summary.zh: 将 attention sink 的形成追溯到 value 聚合引入的位置间方差差异，以及 FFN 超级神经元对差异的放大。论文通过可控干预检验这一因果链，并研究以 head-wise RMSNorm 稳定预训练中的聚合统计量。
